page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfr6.10xlarge is a memory-optimized server instance powered by the x86_64 architecture. It features 40 dedicated physical cores utilizing an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at a clock speed of 3.1 GHz. The system is equipped with 384.0 GB of RAM, providing a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 9.6 GB per core. This instance operates on the KVM hypervisor and does not include local storage or GPU hardware, relying entirely on network-attached storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 12 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks place this instance in the average tier across multiple categories. The Intel Xeon processor achieves a stress-ng single-core score of 1436.39 and a multi-core score of 38318.39, while the PassMark CPU score reaches 34031.19. Memory performance is characterized by a read-only small block cached bandwidth of 2128.36 GB/sec, which drops to 111.38 GB/sec for large block uncached reads, and a write bandwidth of 49.57 GB/sec. For database operations, the instance handles 32.74 million Redis SET operations per second and achieves a PassMark database operations score of 14328.81.

In terms of workload suitability, the high memory density and dedicated CPU allocation make this instance highly effective for memory-intensive applications, in-memory databases, and caching layers. It also supports moderate computational tasks, as demonstrated by a multi-threaded bzip3 decompression speed of 164.02 GB/sec and a static web serving throughput of 24.49 GB/sec. However, the lack of local NVMe storage and GPU accelerators means it is not designed for high-I/O storage-heavy databases or large-scale deep learning training, though it can handle smaller LLM inference tasks, processing 56.33 tokens per second for a 7B model prompt.
